s1.syndrome_frame: Palpitations and syncope in a patient with complex congenital heart disease
salient_findings: Tachycardia with heart rate of 183 bpm
Irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating on ECG
key_facts: Patient has complex congenital heart disease
Patient has D-transposition of the great arteries
Patient has single ventricle physiology
Patient has Fontan circulation
Patient experiences lightheadedness and syncope with walking
Patient has persistent tachycardia and palpitations
ECG shows irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating
Transesophageal echocardiogram shows no intracardiac thrombus
Patient is prescribed diltiazem and apixaban
Heart rate is 183 bpm in the emergency department

shortlist.label: Orthodromic atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has complex congenital heart disease and ECG shows irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating, consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has Fontan circulation, which increases the risk of intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia

shortlist.label: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's ECG shows narrow complex tachycardia with visible P waves in lead II after diltiazem administration, consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.why_kept: Patient's ECG shows irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating, and the presence of complex congenital heart disease increases the risk of aberrancy

shortlist.label: Atrial flutter

shortlist.label: Focal atrial tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has complex congenital heart disease and is at increased risk of focal atrial tachycardia

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG shows irregularly irregular tachycardia with grouped beating and intermittently visible P waves, which is consistent with intra-atrial reentrant tachycardia, a common arrhythmia in patients with Fontan circulation and complex congenital heart disease.

rejected.label: Orthodromic atrioventricular reentrant tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG does not show a consistent pattern of retrograde P waves

rejected.label: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG does not show a typical pattern of atrioventricular nodal reentry

rejected.label: Supraventricular tachycardia with aberrancy
rejected.why: The ECG does not show a wide QRS complex typical of aberrancy

rejected.label: Atrial fibrillation
rejected.why: The ECG shows grouped beating, which is not typical of atrial fibrillation

rejected.label: Atrial flutter
rejected.why: The ECG does not show a typical sawtooth pattern of atrial flutter

rejected.why: The ECG does not show a consistent pattern of ectopic P waves

rejected.label: Focal atrial tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG does not show a consistent pattern of focal atrial activity
